question: For each academic year and department, provide the academic year description, department name, and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects for that department and year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.

    l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,

    l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance,
    STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev
FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l
